description: This file defines the ValidationPipelineBehavior class, which implements a validation middleware for MediatR requests using FluentValidation. It intercepts requests to perform validation and throws an exception if validation fails.

classes.name: ValidationPipelineBehavior
classes.description: A MediatR pipeline behavior that performs validation on requests using multiple validators before proceeding.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Executes validation on the incoming request, throws an exception if validation fails, otherwise continues the pipeline.
